title: EXAMS-V: A Multi-Discipline Multilingual Multimodal Exam Benchmark for Evaluating Vision Language Models
findings: Model performance on the 'Religion' subject (Croatian) ranged from 26.00% (GPT-4V) to 30.00% (GPT-4). Performance on 'Islamic Studies' (Arabic) ranged from 12.00% (GPT-4V) to 32.00% (Gemini-Pro). The paper provides these scores without further qualitative analysis.
